note: Sample tasks written for this site to show the format. They are not taken from any exam.

task: Your class has attended a talk about what towns can do to make everyday travel greener. You have made the notes below:

box: [[bold]][[underline]]Which measures would do most to make travel in towns greener?[[/underline]][[/bold]]
“People will only leave the car at home if the bus costs less.”
“Shops lose customers when cars are kept out.”

task: Write an essay for your tutor discussing [[bold]]two[[/bold]] of the measures in your notes. You should [[bold]]explain which measure would be more effective[[/bold]], [[bold]]giving reasons[[/bold]] in support of your answer.
You may use the opinions from the talk if you wish, but put them in your own words as far as you can.

box:
The college where you study has been given some money to improve one area of student life, and the principal has asked students for proposals.

In your proposal, describe a problem that students face at the moment, explain how the money could be used to solve it, and say how the change would benefit the college as a whole.

task: You see this announcement on a travel website:

box: Have you recently made a journey by train, boat or bus that turned out to be more memorable than the place you were going to?
If so, send us a review of it.
Tell us what made the journey special, mention anything that could have been better, and say what kind of traveller would enjoy it most.

You have just finished a month of voluntary work with an organisation in your area. The organiser has asked you to write a report on the scheme.

Your report should outline what your work involved, evaluate how well the scheme was organised, and suggest improvements for the volunteers who come next.
